name: Rustler's Lasso
text: When this card loses a trick to an opponent, you may create a copy of the winning card in your hand.

signature.trigger: this card loses to an opponent

archetypes: Contract Attacker, Nil Guard; splash High Card
family: Copying cards / Targeted (the card that beat it)
decision: Which trick to lose this card on: under an opponent's ace or high trump the copy becomes a sure winner later, so the owner times the sacrifice; a nil bidder declines the copy.
opponent: Visible when it resolves; opponents answer by winning tricks with lower cards when they can see this card coming.
aiNote: If not on nil, play this card under an opponent's winning ace or spade and take the copy; on nil, decline it.
rationale: Engraving places it on a face card that loses to an opponent in about half of rounds, and the copy of the winner, usually an ace or a trump, is about one extra trick later in the round, so the owner wins back the trick they gave up, about +10 to +15 a round. The copy is a created card: it carries no sigils and is removed after the round.
deviation: Revision 1: replaced Spiteful Eraser, which disabled the winning card's sigil and did nothing until opponents won with engraved cards.
